request.spec: Reject creating an owner whose normalized telephone is already used by any other owner. Respond with 409.
request.prompt:
Implement the following change to the application so that it fully satisfies
the specification and all existing and new tests pass. Run the test suite and
make it green before finishing.

Reject creating an owner whose normalized telephone is already used by any other owner. Respond with 409.

agent.result_text:
All 7 tests pass, including the two new Cp03 duplicate-telephone tests. Build is green.

## Summary

I implemented rejection of owner creation when the normalized telephone already belongs to another owner, returning **409 Conflict**.

The telephone is already normalized before persistence (stripped to 10 digits, per the existing Cp02 rule), so stored values are directly comparable. The change threads a telephone lookup through the app's standard layers:

- **`OwnerRepository`** — added `findByTelephone(String)` to the shared interface.
- **Three repository impls** — implemented it in `SpringDataOwnerRepository` (active `spring-data-jpa` profile, `@Query`), `JpaOwnerRepositoryImpl` (JPQL), and `JdbcOwnerRepositoryImpl` (SQL), so all profiles compile and behave consistently.
- **`ClinicService` / `ClinicServiceImpl`** — added `findOwnerByTelephone(String)` as a read-only facade method, mirroring `findOwnerByLastName`.
- **`OwnerRestControllerV1.addOwner`** — after normalizing the telephone (and before saving), if any existing owner already has that normalized telephone, return `HttpStatus.CONFLICT`.

Distinct telephones still create successfully; duplicates get 409. No existing tests mock `ClinicService` for `addOwner`, so nothing else was affected. Full suite: **7 passed, 0 failed**.
